data.narrative:
Strata Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Eric Zhou and Alex Mason that has raised $5.2M to date. The comparable universe includes one public company (277810.KQ) and eight private peers in Robotics & Manufacturing, though deeper-stage comparables (Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI) operate at scales beyond immediate relevance for Seed-stage valuation anchoring.

The Stage-Progression method provides the sole reliable triangulation vector given data constraints. Using total capital raised ($5.2M) as a baseline proxy for current value and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for progression from Seed to next institutional round yields an implied valuation of $13M. This method is applicable because stage-based step-ups remain empirically grounded for early-stage robotics ventures, though they carry execution risk inherent to any forward-looking multiple. The Peer-Median approach was not applicable; while 10 same-sector peers exist, the dataset contains insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables (fewer than three) to generate a statistically defensible median.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $11M (low) to $15M (high), with a median point of $13M. This narrow band reflects reliance on a single method and absence of corroborating peer data. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the 2.5x multiplier to Strata's specific risk profile and the degree to which disclosed raised capital reflects true economic ownership post-dilution.
